people.name: Elkanah
people.line: The father of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Jeroham
people.line: An Ephraimite, father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel.

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Zuph
people.line: Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet

translations.web: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
translations.bsb: Now there was a man named Elkanah who was from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim. He was the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
